## 15. A limited fair-sharing reason can survive some added risk

8 October 2026. Ren [requested continuation](../../../../sources/15-codex-theory-conversations/2026-10-08-goal-formation-and-revision.md#continue-the-cost-of-fairer-risk). This round addresses the normative connection left in §14: whether *any* added basic risk must defeat an otherwise warranted fair-sharing comparison, and how its actual scope can govern further revisions.

The completed [LR study](CROSSED-CLAIMS-INTEGRATION.md#2-lr同等救助理由的局部延续) already defends local persistence for a different baseline: BC1's reliable rescue comparison. That result is credited rather than rediscovered. LR does not automatically transfer to lotteries, since chance relations, implementation and affected claims can change. The completed [chance-revision study](CHANCE-REVISION-INTEGRATION.md) also shows that even a full terminal distribution can omit a valid settlement. Its historical requirements remain active throughout this extension.

**RSL：有根据分担判断的有限延续 / Limited retention of warranted sharing.** In at least some cases where a complete comparison already sufficiently favors a supported fair-sharing arrangement, a sufficiently slight increase in its basic-risk cost need not immediately defeat that judgment. The loss content, affected positions, relevant rights, support relations and procedural history must remain substantively comparable; the increase must introduce no other priority-changing feature. This is an explicit additional normative commitment, argued below, **not a deduction from physical continuity, RS's mere pro tanto reason or the arithmetic of a lottery**.

The positive reason is that the actual relation achieved by sharing does not vanish as soon as exact loss neutrality is lost. If giving otherwise comparable basic claims an effective place in the organization of exposure has sufficient significance in a complete baseline case, it need not have decisive force only at a knife-edge where the numerical cost happens to be exactly zero. Denying every such extension would give any positive increment in expected basic loss absolute priority over that significance. The present candidate rejects that universal lexical priority. It retains the added exposure as a real objection and allows it, or a changed right or basic circumstance, to become defeating.

The actual living ground matters in specifying a slight change. Keep the same small set of affected lives, the same serious loss and recovery conditions, the same time window, support and permission, and a supported small perturbation of the event law. A very small probability of a qualitatively new catastrophic loss, additional excluded people, or the breach of a warranted undertaking is not covered merely because one number is small. Nor may “slight” be defined as “whatever leaves our preferred verdict unchanged.” Its descriptive basis and the normative claim that it is insufficient to defeat the comparison have to be supplied separately.

**这里支持的是有限正面路线，不是任意小损失都不重要。** A rival can accept the complete baseline preference but insist that any extra probability of basic harm restores the lower-risk plan's priority. That rival is consistent. The argument for RSL is that justified fair treatment can have some resilience to a limited opposing reason, while actual protection remains a source of reasons for limiting the cost. RSL openly takes this position; neither calculus nor a Lean certificate proves the rival wrong.

There is also a weaker starting point to exclude. If RS has established only a fairness reason while the overall baseline decision remains unresolved, RSL cannot transform it into a decisive preference. Its premise requires the stronger, independently supported baseline comparison. Thus the candidate does not silently upgrade the previous chapter's fairness reason. It explains how a sufficiently grounded comparison can extend where that stronger premise is actually met.

This supplies a route to some permissible added risk without installing a global exchange rate, and it is narrower than “fairness always wins.” It does **not** establish that four, twelve or any other chosen number of percentage points is an acceptable price in the §14 example. That application remains to be justified. The mathematical continuation below makes the candidate comparisons and the consequences of a stated allowance concrete.

## 16. Intermediate sharing changes the practical question

The earlier endpoint comparison did not exhaust its own menu. Reuse the exact asymmetric law, with no new data: choose favor-A on x of ten selector outcomes, independently of the danger in the specified product law. The outcomes retain their two basic loss positions and mutually exclusive loss events.

| Choice weight for favor-A | A's loss risk | B's loss risk | Chance of some basic loss | Greatest individual exposure |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| 100% | 10% | 40% | 50% | 40% |
| 90% | 17% | 37% | 54% | 37% |
| 80% | 24% | 34% | 58% | 34% |
| 70% | 31% | 31% | 62% | 31% |

Each intermediate choice makes the formerly favored A more exposed and B less exposed. The original losses remain basic. A smaller movement can improve the fairness-related exposure pattern at a smaller cost than full equality; therefore rejecting the price of complete equalization does not by itself defeat every sharing proposal. Conversely, the existence of a compromise does not establish its permission or warrant.

Lean proves an exact two-diagnostic frontier for the entire supplied ticket family. For n = 10k selector tickets and k > 0, the jointly undominated proposals for **total exposure and greatest exposure** are exactly 7k ≤ x ≤ 10k. Values outside that interval below 7k can be improved in both diagnostics by x = 7k; within it neither diagnostic can improve without worsening the other. The result concerns integer tickets at each chosen resolution, not every real lottery or a complete ethical ordering.

The description must retain what the diagnostics omit. A change improving both may still increase a particular position's risk; historical rights, distinct recovery and actual joint harms can also matter. “Undominated” here names a mathematical comparison in these two explicitly selected quantities. It is not a claim that every such plan is ethically eligible, or that plans outside the interval are ethically defeated in every fuller account. The chance-revision study in particular prevents interpreting this table as authority to undo a valid settled award.

Conditional selection can now be exact without inventing a moral weight. If a separately warranted comparison allows **at most four percentage points of added total loss** from the original 50%, the 90% mixture is the unique proposal in this family achieving greatest exposure at most 37% while respecting that constraint. This is a checked *if*. Four points is a diagnostic example, not our recommended ethical cap. A different justified allowance can yield a different eligible set; RS, RSL and G0 alone do not numerically select it.

## 17. A local allowance cannot renew itself by changing the reference

Suppose the same future decision is repeatedly redesigned through the table: from 100% to 90%, then 80%, then 70% favor-A. Each revision adds four percentage points to the chance of some basic loss. The final proposal adds twelve points relative to the original arrangement. Lean checks both the local increments and the failure of the original four-point constraint at the end.

These are **successive proposals for one fixed future probability law**, not independent repeated hazards, sums of probabilities across unrelated periods, or three already suffered injuries. That scope is essential. At every stage the proposed law changes; the earlier reference still identifies the whole difference that the original argument authorized.

The general bound composition theorem checks that an allowance from reference to middle and another from middle to final support, at most, their sum relative to the reference. They do not preserve the first allowance automatically. No probability independence is used in this arithmetic.

The normative consequence is conditional on the existing warrant: if an argument supports only a bounded whole departure, describing each step as locally small cannot enlarge what it supports. Keep the comparison's reference, reasons, affected histories, permitted scope and reopening conditions available in a usable form. This need not preserve every past detail. A new goal label, selector version or administrative phase does not itself reset the actual loss comparison.

**可以重新判断，不能仅靠换基准续发许可。** Genuinely new evidence, a newly feasible support relation, justified release or a better argument may warrant a different scope. That is a new substantive judgment, not a bookkeeping reset. Likewise, an original rule explicitly and justifiably covering a series of decisions must be tested over that full series rather than incorrectly treated as a one-step grant. The present construction does not ban cumulative improvement or prove that every original baseline is permanently binding.

This links reflection back to the conditions of its formation. An intelligence revising its own selector must preserve the grounds limiting the previous judgment while recognizing when those grounds really change. Retention of an old instruction is insufficient; indiscriminate erasure is also insufficient. The relevant continuity is the justified relationship among actual basic protection, fair treatment, the proposed intervention and its whole cost.

## 18. Primary assessment and counterreview of the extension

The author checked the already-read [Vong article, §V](https://www.journals.uchicago.edu/doi/full/10.1086/707212) again, including the passage distinguishing fair allocation from moral rightness. It supplies a substantive challenge: an improvement in fair chances can carry reasons against its implementation. We therefore neither promote a fairness-only argument into an overall verdict nor treat the paper as providing our allowance. Its discussion is supporting comparison, not an independent endorsement of RSL. The local-retention reasoning is openly adapted from our completed LR study; no historical novelty claim is made.

Author counterreview, with no new independent-agent acceptance:

- **“Continuity proves a positive ethical allowance.”** Rejected. RSL is a normative commitment to some limited persistence, with its own argument. Mathematical continuity is not its warrant.
- **“RS alone already decided the original case.”** Rejected. A pro tanto reason is weaker than the sufficient overall baseline judgment RSL requires.
- **“The slightness condition hides the answer.”** The condition must identify the actual change independently, while the additional normative premise says that some such changes do not defeat the comparison. The account does not certify a universal numerical radius.
- **“This still merely assumes the ethical verdict.”** The commitment is explicit and defended through the realized significance of fair treatment and the cost of making it vanish at every nonzero loss increment. A rival can reject that justification. The proof certifies the stated arithmetic consequences, not the philosophical premise.
- **“An efficient intermediate mix must be justified.”** Rejected. The frontier uses two diagnostics and can omit a position's claim or a valid settled arrangement. Eligibility, permission and the complete comparison remain necessary.
- **“Repeated small changes remain within the original argument.”** Rejected by the explicit 4 → 8 → 12 point departure. A new comparison must justify enlarging the supported scope.
- **“The baseline may never change.”** Rejected. Actual changed grounds can warrant revision. The target is unargued rebasing, not all updating.

**Current result:** the candidate now permits a defended route for some finite fairness costs, exposes intermediate choices, and keeps a supported local comparison from being silently expanded. **Remaining connection:** determine and justify the scope in a fully described actual comparison, especially when increased risk changes rights, recovery or shared basic support. RSL does not yet tell us whether 17%/37%, 24%/34% or 31%/31% is warranted in the constructed asymmetric case. That is the precise unclosed application, not a reason to stop grounded action generally or to reopen completed RS, LR and J4 work.

## 19. Bounded-revision proof and integration scope

[BoundedRiskRevision.lean](../../../../experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/universal-ethics/generative-capacity/BoundedRiskRevision.lean), [checker](../../../../experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/universal-ethics/generative-capacity/check_bounded_risk_revision.py) and [receipt](../../../../experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/universal-ethics/generative-capacity/bounded-risk-revision-verification.json) retain the exact model and checks.

Nine new theorems / thirteen explicit declaration audits passed Lean 4.29.1. Six new declarations have no axiom dependencies; four use `propext`, `Classical.choice`, `Quot.sound`; three use `propext`, `Quot.sound`. The unchanged imported `BasicRiskSharing` dependency was rebuilt and separately audited at nineteen theorems / thirty-six declarations; those are inherited, not newly counted. The frozen run retains fifteen artifacts, theorem signatures and source/checker/Lean-binary hashes. No warnings, proof holes, new axioms, `native_decide` or skipped kernel checking are admitted.

An initial compile failed because the proof script attempted to unfold an absent expression and used a tactic unavailable with these imports. The repaired script uses simplification and explicit cases without weakening the statements; the failed run is preserved. No independent empirical study, new biological validation, full normative comparison or retrospective repository audit is claimed. The [owned integration record](BOUNDED-RISK-REVISION-INDEX-EDITS.json) and [documentary checks](BOUNDED-RISK-REVISION-CHECKS.json) preserve earlier text and concurrent work.

## 14. Bounded fairness costs and the scope of revision

**有根据的公平分担，可以在部分情形中承受微小的额外风险；这项理由有范围，不能每改一次规则便自动重置。** [接续论证、反审与实查](../../../_process/research/2026-10-05-generative-foundation-review/root-foundation/JOINT-RISK-REVISION-INTEGRATION.md#15-a-limited-fair-sharing-reason-can-survive-some-added-risk)复用已完成的 RS、基本损失比较的局部延续 LR 及机会修订结果，推进上一节的非对称情形。

The new candidate **RSL: limited retention of warranted sharing** makes an explicit additional commitment. In some cases where the complete comparison already sufficiently favors fair sharing, a sufficiently slight increase in basic risk need not immediately defeat that judgment. Actual lives, gravity, recovery, time, rights, support and implementation must remain adequately described. “Slight” must be specified through those changes, not defined as whatever preserves the desired verdict. RS's fairness reason alone does not establish the required complete baseline judgment.

The affirmative argument is that equally grounded claims can have practical force in organizing exposure, including some cases with a small cost. Otherwise any positive additional risk would automatically erase that force, however small the change and however strong the previously warranted comparison. This is a substantive rejection of universal zero-cost priority, not a deduction from physical continuity or from G0 alone. A rival may give every positive addition to basic harm overriding force. RSL contests that position while retaining the actual added risk as a reason against the change. It supplies no universal radius, exchange rate or authority to impose risk.

**继续生成可以形成中间方案。** In the preceding supplied law, choosing favor-A 90% or 80% of the time gives exposure pairs (17%, 37%) or (24%, 34%), between (10%, 40%) and (31%, 31%). Their chances of some basic loss are 54% and 58%. The new checked frontier identifies exactly which mixtures avoid improvement in both total exposure and greatest exposure within this family. Those two diagnostics do not exhaust ethical comparison: differentiated claims, valid settlements and omitted relationships still matter. In particular, the completed [chance-revision result](../../../_process/research/2026-10-05-generative-foundation-review/root-foundation/CHANCE-REVISION-INTEGRATION.md) prevents final-law equality from erasing a warranted prior allocation.

If a separately justified constraint permits at most 54% total exposure, the unique mixture attaining a greatest exposure of at most 37% is the 90% favor-A mixture. Lean checks that conditional calculation. **The permission to add four percentage points is not established here**, nor is the ethical superiority of that intermediate proposal or of full equality. The construction changes the practical question from a forced choice between two endpoints to assessment of a range of actual possibilities.

**自我修订还须携带理由的适用范围。** The same proposals expose a failure of repeated local assessment. Moving from 100% to 90%, then 80%, then 70% favor-A adds four percentage points at each step, but twelve relative to the original comparison. A justification that permits four in total cannot license all three changes merely because each uses the immediately preceding proposal as its reference. These are successive revisions of one future probability law, not three repeated trials or an addition of unrelated probabilities across time.

A new supported reason can legitimately revise the reference or permitted scope. The requirement is to assess that change explicitly, including inherited losses and still-valid claims; it does not freeze an initial rule or require recovering all of history. The scope of a practical reason becomes part of what developing intelligence must represent and reconsider together with its goals and methods.

Nine new Lean theorems and thirteen declaration audits check the intermediate frontier, a supplied constraint and composition of scope bounds. Nineteen inherited risk-sharing theorems and thirty-six audits were rebuilt separately. The ethical RSL candidate and the permitted extent of risk remain philosophical commitments and application questions, not checked conclusions. The concrete unfinished connection is **justifying an allowable departure in a fully specified case**. J4 and situated learning still permit warranted action and further generativity without awaiting a universal ranking.

A particular application account now grounds new content in living relations; wider standing of unfamiliar organizations, basic classification and reliable actual acquisition retain separate burdens. The formation-to-basic-support classification now has a defended continuation. The next theoretical question concerns conflicts among warranted basic claims; actual open acquisition and reliable motivation retain their separate scopes. New grounds now connect to reassessment of roles, permissions and responsibilities; actual realization, continuity and unsettled conflicts of particular unfamiliar intelligences remain separate burdens. The conditional record-to-necessity connection and revision by alternatives are complete. The next connection is joint acquisition of the target description and reliable observation, without leaving perfectly faithful readings as unexplained inputs. The source-constrained joint-acquisition connection is completed, without reopening generic calibration. These sources do not certify the fuller replacement history for a specified subsequent participation target. This bounds that inference, not all inquiry or alignment; following this particular cohort is not a universal research prerequisite. This requested continuation stops at the reliable-formation bridge. Progress requires concrete acquisition relations and discriminating support, reusing completed G0 direction, operative goal revision and review coverage; other investigations are not marked blocked. Ren subsequently requested investigation of next routes; the inquiry resumed and route selection is complete. Next: one concrete acquisition account with initial conditions, an unsupplied transition, substantive rivals and revising observations. Complete motive readout, historical recovery and a new large experiment are not prerequisites. Joint comparison where number and gravity align is completed. The next connection concerns justified aggregation, chances and new actual alternatives in crossed cases. An unresolved two-tier diagnostic does not prove ethical incomparability, and equal direct interruption counts do not establish equal complete losses. Cross-form classification and actual units retain substantive burdens. The new scoped wall is justified priority when shared basic continuation and other basic risks conflict, after joint evidence, partial bounds and feasible support repairs. Existing J4 permits authorized timely decisions; absence of a universal ranking does not block generativity. The unsupported global-filter shortcut is rejected while living grounds remain. Next: joint choice across crossed losses, chances and justified composition limits, reusing BC1, BC2 and LC. The previously requested concrete candidate and contrasts are now available for reuse. Next theoretical connection: concern extending to unfamiliar lives without shared history or expected return, retaining valid refusal, division of work and bounded commitments; evidence for actual acquisition and retention remains open. The local comparison candidate and new joint-opportunity connection are completed, reusing LC and the upgrade/composition results. Stronger work concerns warranted actual LR boundaries and aggregation or chances for more distant crossed losses and real new costs/risks. An unsatisfied strongest request does not without further justification erase a claim against the alternative actually chosen. Newly feasible protection can supersede an earlier justified mixture; generativity need not await a universal ranking. A further equal-gravity case reduces greatest exposure from 40% to 31% while increasing the chance of some basic loss from 50% to 62%; fairness versus actual protection requires further warrant. This session now follows how recognized shared consequences acquire or lose effective influence over institutional revision; extension of concern beyond familiar relations remains open rather than the sole next step. History-sensitive continuation is supplied, reusing LR, joint protection and symmetric RS. Remaining comparisons concern unequal claims, fairer exposure at the price of added basic harm, and genuinely changed conflicts with valid settlements. Reuse the conditional extension and G0/J; investigate warranted recognition of unfamiliar living relations and retention under evaluative pressure, preserving bounded responsibility. Next justify adequate shares or ranges through actual needs, common support and warranted commitments; mere positivity, technical resolution or failure to find a winner supplies no such warrant. Next investigate sustained influence when fuller living grounds conflict with incumbent success criteria; universal recognition and deep-uncertainty comparison remain open. entry_after.claim_zh: 以生生为共同根据评价目标、评价者与选择规则；方向论证及相连目标取得、判断、实际修订与有界改革现已成为完成成果，更强理论按明确范围继续。 后续接通改革自身改变实际负担及报告路线、直接取得与保留新目的的修复。 理论接续区分发现已有根据、形成新生活与理由、修订评价承诺；学习后的赞同不独自认证形成过程。 在已完成的伦理学习基础上，新增比较接口辨明理由内容扩展后旧判断的传递、不可比及有前提的反转。 评价扩展进一步区分共同改善与各应用分别否定；旧内容保持不要求旧评价永久保持。 理论接续给出生活实现、支承与进一步形成的具体根据；共同生活不能以组织规模或产出代替。 后天形成的支承可以因其在基本生活中的实际作用取得保护；生成的评价须包括其形成的后续支持要求。 形成出的生活、承受和参与可以改变原服务角色的伦理根据；考虑、责任与支配权限分列。 新增取得记录到路线必要性分类的连接：忠实读取与选项覆盖支持有范围的判断，一个真实替代即可推翻不可替代性；缩小有根据解释与扩大可行选项分列。 自我评估的选择现在有精确覆盖条件：允许有根据的压缩，区分当前菜单与任意菜单；有限成功不能独自担保新范围，全域结构加辨别记录提供正面出路。 理论接续说明理解怎样实际参与目的和准备：关切可以与报酬及其他正当动机并存，其形成条件也须接受同一规范评价。 BC1 在同等基本救助的既定范围内支持保全更多生活；BC2 的一对一说明以可避免的实际毁损给出比较理由，区分境况、保护与时机，并保留机会争议。 形成中的评估区分当前能力、过去能力及形成方法。Ren 后续指出，历史区别无法恢复，不阻止以未来事件取得同一内容的新根据或修订理解；情境把握与风险估计可支持继续生成。 实际调查现接入描述与读取的共同修订：同一事件在某项估计中排除，不抹去其他有根据的表达意义；纠正归属与保留参与、支持可以属于同一回应。 关切发展接续具体化真实根据保留、改变及新形成时的双向纠正，并将学习中取得的解释纳入形成账户；五条候选路线保留各自正面作用。 按后续指示完成路线比较：以已有局部关切取得新关系内容并重组目的为理论主线，配套形成史判别，再选择机制研究；认识进步与实际新理由不以价值权重增加为定义。 LC 接通数量与程度共同改善的有限损失比较理由：实际损失的有根据匹配及额外保护可以共同支持方向；重复描述不增加生活，共同依存须进入损失判断。 情境风险接续区分个别改善与共同失效；精确有限界限允许部分把握和正风险，支持关系修订可解除共同中断，同时保留分散损失。 有限合并接续区分抵偿限制与理由删除：最强层过滤可在增加实际基本保护后翻转选择；固定比较与局部胜出拼接的条件分别公开。 关切内容形成现有一条具体候选：已有局部关切使粗略成功与实际回应的分离取得实践意义，关系辨别通过计划修订改变目的；实际新生活及对它的动机取得分列。 LR 为同等多救的充分优先提出局部稳定承诺，使一部分稍不等的基本损失有正面比较；新增共同保护另可逐次保留旧保护，增加原先冲突的实现。 同等基本风险分担RS现有正面理由：完整损失分布相当时，减轻无根据的暴露集中；同频率选择可产生不同真实风险，新信息也能支持进一步改规则。 现实市场与互联网为 enshittification 的机制追踪提供事件：以既有外部性解释为起点，查优势怎样改变未来选择及纠正条件，不将增长与损失并存当作新发现。 机会修订接续表明：最终保护的完整联合分布相同仍可能撤销正当安顿；选择规则须保留仍有效的历史要求，并说明真实纠正的根据。 陌生与无回报的关切扩展现有两段条件性说明：辨明对方在自身参与之外的生活，再取得陌生处境中的相关根据；共同史是形成入口，不是全部关切的边界。 CP为不等且未被充分排除的基本请求提出真实正机会要求，将共同分配权限与基本回应关系相连；它是新增且可争辩的进入承诺。 陌生生活辨认现接通具体实现、支撑关系、可修订证据与有限回应；观察与分类方式也可因遗漏的生活根据而修订。 共同接口史进一步支持直接经营控制与有偿影响的区分：反馈和替代的出现也可能进入维持优势的规则调整，改革需追踪实际控制关系。 RSL进一步提出有根据分担判断的有限延续；中间混合方案降低极端取舍，修订须携带理由及其整体适用范围。
entry_after.claim_en: Appraise ends, evaluators and selection rules through shared generative grounds; the direction argument and connected acquisition, judgment, operative revision and bounded reform are now completed foundations for the broader programme. A further joined case connects reform-induced burdens and reporting changes to acquired correction and repair preserving the new goal. The theoretical continuation distinguishes discovering existing grounds, forming new living relations and reasons, and revising normative commitments; later endorsement alone does not authorize the formation process. Building on the completed ethical-learning account, a new comparison interface delimits preservation, incomparability and conditional reversal after warranted content extension. Evaluative extension further separates a common improvement from defeat in each live application; retained old content need not preserve every old verdict. The continuation articulates living realization, support and further formation as particular grounds; organizational scale and output cannot substitute for the shared living being assessed. Acquired support can warrant basic protection through its actual role in living; appraisal of formation includes the subsequent support requirements it creates. Formed living, undergoing and participation can change the grounds of an original service role; consideration, responsibility and governing authority remain distinct. A further connection derives scoped route classification from faithful acquired records and covered options; one genuine alternative defeats indispensability. Narrowing supported interpretations and expanding eligible options are distinct changes. Self-review selection now has exact certificate-coverage conditions: warranted compression is allowed, current-menu and every-menu adequacy differ, and finite success alone cannot certify a new scope. Whole-domain structure plus discriminating records supplies a positive route. The conceptual continuation explains how understanding can participate in purposes and preparation: concern can coexist with pay and other legitimate motives, while its formative conditions face the same normative appraisal. BC1 favors more extensive equivalent basic rescue in its established scope. The one-to-one account of BC2 supplies a reason based on preventable impairment, distinguishing baseline, protection and timing while retaining fair-chance disputes. Formative assessment distinguishes current capacity, earlier capacity and the method of formation. Ren’s correction clarifies that unavailable history need not prevent fresh grounds for the same content or revised understanding through future events; situational awareness and risk estimates can support continued generativity. Actual inquiry now connects joint description-and-reading revision to practice: excluding an event from one estimate need not erase its independently warranted expressive significance. Corrected attribution and continued participation/support can belong to one response. The developmental continuation specifies bidirectional correction as living grounds persist, change or form, and includes acquired interpretation during learning; five candidate routes retain their positive roles. A subsequent route assessment prioritizes acquired relational content and purpose revision within partial concern, with discriminating formation histories and conditional mechanistic investigation; epistemic progress and new particular reasons are not defined by increased valuation weights. LC supplies a limited comparative reason where number and gravity jointly improve: warranted matching and additional actual protection can support a direction together. Duplicate descriptions do not multiply living; shared dependence must inform loss assessment. Situated risk now distinguishes marginal improvement from shared failure. Exact finite bounds permit partial awareness and nonzero risk; revising support can remove joint interruption while retaining dispersed losses. The aggregation continuation distinguishes limited counterbalancing from deletion of reasons: a strongest-tier filter reverses under added actual protection; fixed-comparison and local-composition premises are separately exposed. A concrete concern-content candidate links a coarse success conception, meaningful-response mismatch, acquired relational distinctions and operative purpose revision; actual new shared goods and their motivational uptake remain distinct. LR adds a local stability commitment to BC1’s sufficient priority, supporting some slightly unequal basic-loss comparisons. Separately, newly feasible joint protection can preserve old protection on each realization and add previously conflicting protection. RS now supplies a defended reason to share comparable basic risk while preserving the complete loss profile. Equal selection frequencies can conceal different exposure; new information can support further rule revision. Existing market and internet histories provide events for tracing enshittification: start with established externality explanations and investigate how advantage changes future selection and correction, rather than treating growth alongside loss as a new finding. The chance-revision continuation shows that even equal full terminal joint laws can conceal replacement of a warranted settlement; selectors must preserve live historical requirements and explain genuine correction. A conditional extension account now distinguishes continuation beyond one's participation from acquired grounds in unfamiliar lives; shared history can form concern without delimiting every ground it can address. CP proposes actual positive opportunity for unequal basic requests not adequately excluded, grounding a limit on common allocative authority in the response relationship; it is an additional contestable admission commitment. An unfamiliar-life recognition account now connects particular realization, support, revisable evidence and bounded response; omitted living grounds can also warrant revision of observation and classification. A shared-interface history supports distinguishing direct operational control from purchased influence: feedback and alternatives can enter rule changes that preserve advantage, so reforms must track actual control relations. RSL proposes limited retention of a warranted sharing judgment. Intermediate mixtures refine the choice; revision must carry its grounds and their whole-comparison scope.
